shortDesc: Intelligent logic gate optimizer finding minimal layouts for boolean transformations.
fullDesc:
An intelligent system designed to calculate and map the minimum number of logic gates required to perform any arbitrary boolean transformation.

Core Idea:
The optimizer utilizes state-space search and graph pruning algorithms to search the topological combinations of basic gates (AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND). It minimizes gate counts and propagation delays, serving as a helper tool for digital design validation and circuit optimization.
highlights: Finds the absolute minimal logic gate combinations for custom truth tables
Uses graph pruning and branch-and-bound logic to search space efficiently
